_comment: Flask HTML routes not reachable through the Cloudflare routing tables, measured 2026-09-05 against dchub-frontend@dbce499a8 (_routes.json 97/98 rules: 82 include + 15 exclude) and this repo at the commit that introduced the file. RATCHET: scripts/check_route_table_coherence.py fails on any NEW entry, so these lists may SHRINK BUT NEVER GROW. Nothing here is fixed by the commit that added it — the entries are recorded so that new mis-registration is visible. TWO LISTS, because the two tables fail differently and a path must not be allowed to migrate silently between them: missing_routes_json means the worker is NEVER INVOKED (404, or a same-named static file answers with NO x-dc-worker-version header — read that header PER PATH); missing_worker means the worker runs and declines to forward (403). THIS IS A DEBT REGISTER, NOT AN ALLOW-LIST. When a route here becomes covered the checker prints a ::notice:: naming it and you delete the line; that is how a payment gets recorded. Do NOT add an entry to silence a route you just broke — the fix is normally an entry in _routes.json 'include', and the cap is 98 rules counting include AND exclude together — measured 98/98, ZERO FREE, on 2026-09-16, so the next rule added is dropped SILENTLY; re-measure it, never quote this number (run `node scripts/check-edge-caps.mjs` in dchub-frontend; the cap is not stated anywhere in the file). SPOT-CHECKED AGAINST PRODUCTION on 2026-09-05, 13 paths, 13 agreeing: every path this register calls uncovered answered with NO x-dc-worker-version header (/ui 404, /industry 404, /blog 404, /security 404, /status 301, /app 308, /pipeline 301, /dcpi/methodology 308, /iso/ercot 301, /iso/ercot.json 404), and every path it calls covered answered WITH one (/team, /pockets, /dcpi, /upgrade, /markets, /radar, /iso, /redeem, /spare-capacity, /news/some-article). That probe is what found three false entries — /iso, /redeem and /spare-capacity are listed in _routes.json only as '/x/*', which DOES route the bare '/x'. Roughly 30 of these are known-dead or deliberately static: six 'static twins' (/cited-by, /system-status, /competitive, /watchlist, /feedback, /tax-incentives) where a static file is the correct thing to serve, four of whose handler files also serve the live /api/v1/* endpoints those pages call — deleting them would break the pages they appear to shadow. This register does NOT authorise deleting anything; its job is preventing NEW mis-registration. TO RE-MEASURE after a legitimate change: run the three phases (`python3 scripts/check_route_table_coherence.py flask-routes|route-tables|diff`) with a current dchub-frontend checkout and move only the lines the diff names. There is deliberately no --write-baseline flag: a guard that can bless itself is not a guard. ★ WORKER HALF IS ADVISORY. missing_routes_json FAILS the build; missing_worker does NOT. All 47 static worker-only entries were probed at the live edge on 2026-09-05 and 9 came back with x-railway-request-id — the origin answered them, so the model was wrong. PHASE_282 membership is SUFFICIENT for forwarding, not NECESSARY: _worker.js has 9 proxy call sites, zone-level routes reach Railway without the Pages worker running at all (/agents-md, /agents-md-inline, /mcp-server-card.json come back with NO x-dc-worker-version), and the whole /mcp family answers 200 from the WORKER ITSELF and never reaches Flask. See the 'WHY THE WORKER HALF DOES NOT BLOCK' section of scripts/check_route_table_coherence.py. worker_measured_forwarded below is the measured exception list, subtracted from missing_worker; add to it only with a live probe as evidence. ★ 2026-09-16 — /spare-capacity AND /spare-capacity/<ref> ARE NOT BROKEN, AND THESE TWO LINES ARE NOT A SILENCED BREAKAGE. They are 301 stubs (routes/spare_capacity.py): the spare-capacity marketplace was folded into Capacity Source on 2026-09-13 (#4523) and both paths redirect to /listings. dchub-frontend#1491 (a5dd680ba, 2026-09-16T01:39Z) then DELIBERATELY swapped the '/spare-capacity/*' include for '/listings/*' — _routes.json was already full and the deploy DEFERS the newest exact include past the cap, dropping it with no error — and moved both redirects into _redirects, a separate and far roomier table (124/2000 static on 2026-09-16). Measured live 2026-09-16: GET /spare-capacity 301 -> /listings#list-capacity; GET /spare-capacity/abc-def and GET /spare-capacity/123 301 -> /listings; none carried x-dc-worker-version or x-railway-request-id, i.e. the edge answers them with neither the worker nor Railway involved. The Flask handlers are therefore genuinely unreachable — which is exactly what this register records — and that is the INTENDED end state, not drift. DO NOT 'fix' these with include entries: it would spend two rules on a table with zero free in order to proxy to Railway for a 301 Cloudflare already serves for free. ★ ROOT CAUSE, AND IT WILL RECUR: this checker models _routes.json and _worker.js ONLY. It does not read _redirects, so ANY path whose edge behaviour lives there reads as uncovered here. These two lines are that blind spot, not a routing defect.
